events.subtitle: New York premiere for eight cellists
events.factual_description: Roulette announces the New York premiere of Michael Gordon's 8 on January 20, 2027 at 8:00 p.m., performed by the eight cellists named in the lineup. Gordon is not billed as a performer.

en.why_it_matters: Eight cellos for a single Michael Gordon work, including players Ashley Bathgate and Jeffrey Zeigler. This local premiere is an unusually intense way to hear the composer's large-ensemble imagination at Roulette.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this Brooklyn night on a New York trip; compelling A+, not a reason to fly just for the show.
en.listen_before: Michael Gordon — Timber and Decasia as context, not announced repertoire.

es.why_it_matters: Ocho violonchelos para una sola obra de Michael Gordon, con músicos como Ashley Bathgate y Jeffrey Zeigler. El estreno neoyorquino promete escuchar muy de cerca una escritura instrumental fuera de escala.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio a esta noche en Brooklyn si hay viaje a Nueva York; merece A+, sin obligar a cambiar todo el itinerario.
es.listen_before: Michael Gordon — Timber y Decasia como contexto, no como repertorio anunciado.

events.subtitle: Jobim Centennial Celebration

venue.name: Rose Theater at Jazz at Lincoln Center

events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents Eliane Elias's Jobim Centennial Celebration January 29–30, 2027 at 7:30 p.m. in Rose Theater, with Marc Johnson, Rafael Barata and Leandro Pellegrino. The presenter announces songs from her forthcoming album.

en.why_it_matters: Eliane Elias interprets Jobim with Marc Johnson, Rafael Barata and Leandro Pellegrino. Material from her announced new record gives the centennial a particular Brazilian-jazz voice beyond the standards.
en.trip_verdict: Worth knowing about if a New York visit is already planned; a strong Brazil-jazz program but not a trip-defining night.
en.listen_before: Eliane Elias's earlier Jobim interpretations; new album availability not assumed.

es.why_it_matters: Eliane Elias vuelve a Jobim con Marc Johnson, Rafael Barata y Leandro Pellegrino. El material de su disco anunciado le da al homenaje una voz propia dentro del jazz brasileño.
es.trip_verdict: Vale la pena tenerlo presente si ya vas a Nueva York; un buen programa de jazz brasileño, no motivo para reorganizar el viaje.
es.listen_before: Las versiones de Jobim que ya grabó Elias; no doy por disponible el álbum anunciado.

events.artist: Mulligan and Me — Ted Nash and Paul Nedzela
events.subtitle: Gerry Mulligan Centennial: a play with live jazz

venue.name: The Appel Room at Jazz at Lincoln Center

lineup: Ted Nash — music director and Mulligan collaborator
events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents Mulligan and Me, a play with live jazz about Gerry Mulligan's artistic relationship with Judy Holliday, written by Iris Dart and directed by Rachel Dart, with music directed by Mulligan collaborator Ted Nash and saxophonist Paul Nedzela. The Appel Room performances are June 4, 2027 at 7:00 and 9:00 p.m. and June 5 at 4:30 and 7:00 p.m.

en.why_it_matters: A Mulligan centennial with a specific dramatic idea: his artistic relationship with Judy Holliday becomes a play with jazz. Ted Nash knew Mulligan's music firsthand; Paul Nedzela brings the baritone saxophone into the story.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for an Appel Room performance if a June New York trip is possible. The theater-jazz bridge merits A+, not a once-in-a-lifetime claim.
en.listen_before: Mulligan's classic pianoless quartet records; the show's exact set list is not published.

es.why_it_matters: Este centenario de Mulligan sí tiene una propuesta particular: llevar su vínculo creativo con Judy Holliday al teatro con jazz en vivo. Ted Nash conoció esa música de cerca y Paul Nedzela pone el saxo barítono.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría un espacio a una función en The Appel Room si hay viaje a Nueva York en junio. El cruce de teatro y jazz merece A+, sin venderlo como irrepetible.
es.listen_before: Los clásicos cuartetos de Mulligan sin piano; no se ha publicado el repertorio preciso de la función.
